title.zh: 形成的接触改变复制保真度

statement.en: A copy attaching at each site what its contacts read makes a word exactly when every site reads its token, the pool supplies it and the support covers its draws; in the contact machine, loss, displacement and rebinding change the successor by changing what sites read, never by rewriting the product.
statement.zh: 在每一位接上其接触所读之物的复制产生一个词，恰当每一位读到该词的记号、池供给该词且支持覆盖其所取；在接触机中，接触的丢失、错位与重接通过改变各位所读来改变后继，从不改写产物。

laws.en: For every alphabet with decidable equality, every law of draws and every reading of sites: a copy that attaches at each site what the reading gives there, with as many tokens pending as the word has, makes its product what was built followed by the word exactly when every site from the product's end reads the word's token, the pool supplies the word and the support covers what it draws; its product only grows.
laws.zh: 对每个有可判定相等的字母表、每条汲取律与每种位点读取：在每一位接上读取所给之物、待接记号与词一样多的复制，使产物成为已建者接上该词，恰当自产物末端起每一位读到该词的记号、池供给该词且支持覆盖其所取；其产物只增长。

laws.en: A reading copy's moves go along its law's orbit, and a plan of k moves of a determined law completes exactly when the goal holds on its orbit at k. So, with as many tokens pending as the word has, the reading copy's plan of that many moves adds the word exactly when every site reads its token, the pool supplies it and the support covers its draws. Along every course of the plain copy's process its product only grows.
laws.zh: 读作过程：读取复制的诸步沿其律的轨道进行；确定之律的 k 步计划完成，恰当目标在其轨道第 k 处成立。所以待接记号与词一样多时，读取复制步数等于词长的计划接上该词，恰当每一位读到该词的记号、池供给该词且支持覆盖其所取。沿不读取的复制过程的每段进程，其产物只增长。

laws.en: For every process, an output is extended along every course exactly when every step extends it. For every gate on moves, a quantity is kept along every course of ungated moves exactly when every ungated step keeps it, and where every ungated step keeps it, a course that changes it contains a gated move.
laws.zh: 对每个过程：输出沿每段进程被延伸，恰当每一步都延伸它。对动作上的每个门：一个量沿每段非门控动作的进程保持，恰当每个非门控步都保持它；每个非门控步都保持它时，改变它的进程含一个门控动作。

laws.en: In the contact machine one copy move is one core move reading through the actual contacts. For every state with as many tokens pending as a word has, that many copy moves extend the product by the word exactly when each site reads its token through the actual contacts, the pool supplies it and the support covers its draws; where the product's bonds are the path on its tokens, it is then the strand, bonds included.
laws.zh: 在接触机中，一次复制动作即经实际接触读取的核心复制的一步。对待接记号与词一样多的每个状态，那么多次复制动作把产物延伸该词，恰当每一位经实际接触读到该词的记号、池供给该词且支持覆盖其所取；产物的键是其记号上的路径时，产物于是即该链（含键）。

laws.en: Every course of the contact machine keeps the product's bonds the path on its tokens. With complete contacts on a template, its tokens and any tail pooled and the free support covering its draws, the product is the template's tokens, and is the template, bonds included, exactly when the template's bonds are the path on its tokens; the earlier inheritance theorem is the instance, its nonempty premise dropped.
laws.zh: 接触机的每段进程都保持产物的键为其记号上的路径。在模板上接触完整、池中有其记号加任意尾部、自由支持覆盖其所取时，复制的产物即模板的记号；它即模板（含键），恰当模板的键是其记号上的路径；此前的继承定理是其实例，不需非空前提。

laws.en: With contacts complete and the template equal to the product followed by what is pending, n copy moves of the contact machine are n steps of the earlier copying machine.
laws.zh: 接触完整、模板等于产物接上待接者时，接触机的 n 次复制动作即此前复制机的 n 步。

laws.en: In the contact machine only copy moves change the product: docking, loss and slip keep it, a course of contact moves keeps it, and a course that changes it contains a copy move. Every course extends the product, and every admitted finite history keeps its built prefix and its totals of contacts with spare connectors, of tokens built with pooled, and of free with used support.
laws.zh: 在接触机中只有复制动作改变产物：对接、丢失与错位保持它，接触动作的进程保持它，改变它的进程含一次复制动作。每段进程都延伸产物；每段被容许的有限历史都保持其已建前缀，以及接触与备用连接件之和、已建与池中记号之和、自由与已用支持之和。

laws.en: In witnesses on the alternating template with an unlike attachment drawing less: with no contacts four copy moves change nothing; losing a contact stalls the copy after one token with support still free; a slipped contact changes the copied word; slipping another contact to a site of the same token leaves its reading unchanged; and losing and rebinding the slipped contact before copying restores the faithful copy.
laws.zh: 在交替模板、异类之后接合汲取较少的见证中：没有接触时四次复制动作什么也不改变；丢失一个接触使复制在一个记号后停滞，而支持仍有余；一个错位的接触改变所复制的词；把另一个接触错位到同一记号之位，其所读不变；复制前丢失并重接错位的接触，恢复忠实的复制。

laws.en: Correcting a contact does not rewrite the past, in a witness: copying one token, slipping the next contact, copying, then losing and rebinding it and copying the rest leaves the wrong token in the product with the contacts complete, the support used up and the product unreleased.
laws.zh: 纠正接触不改写过去，见于一个见证：复制一个记号、使下一个接触错位、再复制，然后丢失并重接它、复制其余，产物中留下错误记号，接触完整、支持用尽、产物未释放。

laws.en: In a witness, two states with the same template, copy in progress, spare connectors and number of contacts differ in their contacts; with the same counts of contacts and spares, free and used support, pool and product, they copy different words, so no function of those totals gives what is copied.
laws.zh: 两个状态模板、进行中的复制、备用连接件与接触数都相同，而接触不同；接触数与备用数、自由与已用支持、池与产物都相同时，它们复制出不同的词，所以这些总量的任何函数都给不出所复制者。

laws.en: An erroneous daughter is inherited faithfully, in a witness: the word copied through a slipped contact, released, is reproduced as it is by the earlier copying machine.
laws.zh: 错误的子代被忠实继承，见于一个见证：经错位接触复制并释放的词，由此前的复制机按原样复制。

laws.en: In a witness on the alternating template, docking a contact at each of its four sites takes the four spare connectors and four units of support and makes the contacts complete.
laws.zh: 在交替模板的一个见证中：在其四个位各对接一个接触，用去四个备用连接件与四个单位支持，并使接触完整。

hypotheses.zh: 索引位置与选择性对接、可靠取值、局部接合汲取及事件发生给定；没有切除或替换已成产物的操作。
hypotheses.en: Indexed sites, selective docking, reliable transduction, local attachment draws and event occurrence are supplied; there is no excision or replacement of built material.

hypotheses.zh: 一般继承组合要求每个值经完整接触读出、模板与前缀／剩余序列一致，且保留原定理的路径及材料／支持前提（非空前提不需要）。
hypotheses.en: The general inheritance composition requires every value read through complete contacts and template/prefix/suffix consistency, retaining the prior path and material/support premises (the nonempty premise is not needed).

The core laws hold for every alphabet with decidable equality, every law of draws and every reading of sites; the machine's tokens are Boolean and its counts of connectors, tokens and support natural numbers.
hypotheses.zh: 核心规律对每个有可判定相等的字母表、每条汲取律与每种位点读取成立；该机的记号是布尔值，连接件、记号与支持的计数是自然数。

does_not_show.en: Indexed recognition and transduction, rates of damage, the start of repair, excision, an autonomous provision and selection in a population do not follow from these laws.
does_not_show.zh: 由这些规律推不出索引识别与取值、损伤率、纠错的启动、切除、自供或种群中的选择。

does_not_show.en: A strong rival keeping the same contact mechanism explains as much.
does_not_show.zh: 保留同一接触机制的强对手具有同样的解释能力。

detail.zh: 缺接可在有材料和支持时停滞；连接错位未必改值，重接不追改旧产物，连接数和全部复制状态相同仍可产出不同序列。
detail.en: Missing contacts stall despite stock/support; displacement need not change the value, rebinding does not rewrite old output, and matched contact counts/full copying state can produce different sequences.

correspondence.en: Roles differentiate through docking, reading, transfers and retention in common activity; reading through contacts consists of actual position pairs, not a success flag. Local discrimination remains supplied by the equal-index docking guard.

conditions.zh: 连接在所比较的连续复制操作中保持；损失／错位的混合历史不自动满足。
conditions.en: Contacts remain stable during the compared copying operations; mixed histories with loss/displacement need not qualify.
